error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the add-on at this URL.

print_file.name: Print file
print_file.description: Sends a .gcode.3mf file to a printer as a cloud print through the add-on.

device_id.name: Printer
device_id.description: Printer device, as registered by the printer integration.

serial.name: Serial
serial.description: Printer serial number, used when no device is given.

file.name: File
file.description: Path relative to /media/druckwerk, or an absolute path under /media or /share.

force.name: Force
force.description: Send even if the printer is running or paused.

get_printers.name: Get printers
get_printers.description: Returns the printers you may use: status, progress, remaining time and end time, layer, temperatures, AMS trays (unit and slot, type, colour, remaining), HMS errors, the current job and the queue length. Read-only. The serial and the AMS trays feed the other actions.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Only this printer: serial number, printer name or device id. Empty returns all printers you may use.

get_queue.name: Get queue
get_queue.description: Returns the print queue: waiting jobs per printer serial and for "any" (each with its 0-based position, as reorder_job takes it), jobs that wait for approval, running jobs and optionally the latest finished jobs. Read-only.

history_limit.name: History limit
history_limit.description: How many finished jobs to include, newest first. 0 for none.

add_to_queue.name: Add to queue
add_to_queue.description: Adds a job to the print queue; it does not start a print. Give exactly one of file (a sliced .gcode.3mf that is already in the share) or slice_job_id (a variant from druckwerk.slice). A person who needs approval creates a job that waits for an admin. Starting is a separate step that needs the person's confirmation.

file.name: File
file.description: Name of a sliced .gcode.3mf in the share. Use this or slice_job_id.

slice_job_id.name: Slice job
slice_job_id.description: Job id of a finished slice from druckwerk.slice. Use this or file.

target.name: Target
target.description: Printer serial number or name, or "any" for the first free printer of the model.

model.name: Model
model.description: Printer model for target "any", for example H2S. Needed when the printers have different models.

options.name: Options
options.description: Print options as booleans: timelapse, bed_leveling, use_ams.

slice.name: Slice model
slice.description: Slices a model in good, better and best quality for one printer and AMS tray, and returns print time, filament grams and cost for each variant plus the slice job ids. Long-running: the slicer runs one slice at a time, so expect 1 to 5 minutes per variant and 3 to 15 minutes for the call, which waits up to 30 minutes. With wait false it returns the slice job ids at once; poll them with druckwerk.get_slice. Show the variants to the person, let them choose, then call add_to_queue with the chosen slice_job_id.

model_file.name: Model file
model_file.description: Absolute path of the model (.stl, .3mf, .obj, .step) under /share or /media.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Printer serial number, printer name or device id. You need an active grant on it.

tray.name: Tray
tray.description: Loaded AMS tray as unit:slot, both 0-based, as get_printers lists them. 0:0 is the first slot of the first AMS.

plate.name: Build plate
plate.description: Build plate type. Empty uses the printer's default.

wait.name: Wait
wait.description: Wait for the slices to finish and return their results. False returns the slice job ids immediately.

get_slice.name: Get slice results
get_slice.description: Returns state, print time, grams and cost of slice jobs, for example after druckwerk.slice with wait false. Read-only.

cancel_job.name: Cancel job
cancel_job.description: Cancels a waiting job. Users cancel their own jobs; printer admins cancel any job. A job that already started runs on the printer and cannot be cancelled here.

job_id.name: Job
job_id.description: Queue job id (12 hex characters) from get_queue.

reorder_job.name: Reorder job
reorder_job.description: Moves a waiting job to a position in the queue. Users reorder only within the slots of their own jobs; printer admins reorder any job.

job_id.name: Job
job_id.description: Queue job id (12 hex characters) from get_queue.

position.name: Position
position.description: New 0-based position among the waiting jobs (of the printer, when printer is set).

printer.name: Printer scope
printer.description: Count positions among the waiting jobs of this printer only. Empty counts all waiting jobs.

move_job.name: Move job
move_job.description: Changes the target of a waiting job to another printer or to "any". Needs admin on the current and on the new printer.

job_id.name: Job
job_id.description: Queue job id (12 hex characters) from get_queue.

target.name: Target
target.description: New printer serial number or name, or "any".

model.name: Model
model.description: Printer model, needed when the target is "any" and the job has none.

skip_job.name: Skip job
skip_job.description: Sends a waiting job to the end of the queue so the next one comes first. Printer admins only.

job_id.name: Job
job_id.description: Queue job id (12 hex characters) from get_queue.

approve_job.name: Approve job
approve_job.description: Approves a job that waits for approval so it becomes queued. Printer admins only.

job_id.name: Job
job_id.description: Queue job id (12 hex characters) from get_queue.

reject_job.name: Reject job
reject_job.description: Rejects a job that waits for approval; it is cancelled. Printer admins only.

job_id.name: Job
job_id.description: Queue job id (12 hex characters) from get_queue.

retry_job.name: Retry job
retry_job.description: Puts a failed or cancelled job from the history back into the queue. Printer admins only.

job_id.name: Job
job_id.description: Queue job id (12 hex characters) from get_queue.

start_next.name: Start next job
start_next.description: Starts the next queued job on a printer. Printer admins only. SAFETY: this heats and moves a printer. Before calling, show the person the sliced plate review and a current camera snapshot (druckwerk.camera_snapshot), ask whether the plate is clear and the print may start, and call only after an explicit yes. Both plate_clear and confirmed_by_person must be true, otherwise the call is refused.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Printer serial number, printer name or device id. get_printers lists them.

plate_clear.name: Plate clear
plate_clear.description: Must be true: the build plate is empty and clean. Only set it after the person has looked at the current camera snapshot.

confirmed_by_person.name: Confirmed by person
confirmed_by_person.description: Must be true: the person has seen the sliced plate review and a current camera snapshot and explicitly said the print may start. An agent must never set this on its own.

start_job.name: Start job
start_job.description: Starts a chosen queued job on a printer, skipping the queue order. Printer admins only. SAFETY: this heats and moves a printer. Before calling, show the person the sliced plate review and a current camera snapshot (druckwerk.camera_snapshot), ask whether the plate is clear and the print may start, and call only after an explicit yes. Both plate_clear and confirmed_by_person must be true, otherwise the call is refused.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Printer serial number, printer name or device id. get_printers lists them.

job_id.name: Job
job_id.description: Queue job id (12 hex characters) from get_queue.

plate_clear.name: Plate clear
plate_clear.description: Must be true: the build plate is empty and clean. Only set it after the person has looked at the current camera snapshot.

confirmed_by_person.name: Confirmed by person
confirmed_by_person.description: Must be true: the person has seen the sliced plate review and a current camera snapshot and explicitly said the print may start. An agent must never set this on its own.

camera_snapshot.name: Camera snapshot
camera_snapshot.description: Takes a current picture from the printer's camera and saves it as /media/druckwerk/<serial>-<time>.jpg; returns the path and a media source id. Takes 10 to 60 seconds when the camera tunnel is closed. Show it to the person before a start. Needs an active grant on the printer.

printer.name: Printer
printer.description: Printer serial number, printer name or device id. get_printers lists them.

init.title: Druckwerk
init.description: Upload secret: agents upload sliced files with PUT /api/druckwerk/upload/<name>.gcode.3mf and the header X-Druckwerk-Secret (empty turns uploads off). Hub secret: normally set by app discovery; paste it here otherwise (empty keeps the current one). Recipients: YAML map of person entity to notify service, e.g. person.anna: notify.mobile_app_anna; they are notified only while at home.

error.invalid_hub_secret: The hub rejected this secret or is not reachable.
